A1.justification: Both PDFs describe DarkIR and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, references and supplementary material. Retained and relocated content can be matched reliably.

before.justification: V1 reports original DarkIR evaluations on synthetic and real images, including quantitative comparisons and architecture, loss and feature-propagation ablations.

after.justification: V2 retains original DarkIR experiments and adds unpaired-dataset results in appendix Table C and component ablations in Table 6.

M1.justification: The Fourier-amplitude encoder, dilated decoder, skip connections and loss terms and weights remain unchanged. The additional phase-transform and depthwise configurations are ablations rather than revisions to the proposed method.

E1.justification: Appendix Table C adds DICM, LIME, MEF, NPE and VV evaluations, substantially broadening unpaired real-world testing from night-blur images to general low-light enhancement benchmarks. Existing LOLBlur, Real-LOLBlur, LOLv2, LSRW and appendix RealBlur-Night coverage is retained.

E2.justification: Table 2 adds RetinexFormer followed by NAFNet and NAFNet followed by RetinexFormer. Table C introduces CIDNet as an evaluated comparator. Existing end-to-end comparators remain; the Chen pipeline already appeared in v1 despite its changed citation.

E3.justification: The new unpaired evaluations use BRISQUE alongside NIQE, introducing BRISQUE into the evaluation protocol. Existing dataset splits, training hyperparameters, crop sizes and benchmark metrics remain documented as before; no revised settings explain the changed multi-task scores.

E4.justification: Table 6 adds tests of transforming Fourier phase and removing the decoder's extra depthwise convolution. Table 3 removes the LOL-only DarkIR-lol results, losing the comparison with multi-task training. Existing attention, scaling, loss and feature-propagation ablations remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests or uncertainty estimates for its experimental results.

E6.justification: Table 3 changes DarkIR-mt's LOLv2-Real PSNR/SSIM from 32.43/0.922 to 23.87/0.880, removes DarkIR-lol and adds multi-task synthetic results of 25.54/0.934. LSRW changes from 18.720/0.568 to 18.93/0.583, and multi-task LOLBlur PSNR changes from 26.5 to 26.62 dB. Additional pipeline, ablation, MAC and unpaired-dataset entries are reported. The principal LOLBlur and Real-LOLBlur tables otherwise retain their scores; the multi-task revisions are unexplained.

T1.justification: Equations 1–10 and their mathematical content are retained. Explicitly identifying x in the image-formation equation clarifies existing notation without adding a definition, assumption or derivation of substantive novelty.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about efficient joint restoration, state-of-the-art performance and real-world generalization. Specifying PSNR for the existing approximately 1 dB advantage clarifies its wording.

C2.justification: The encoder/decoder mechanism explanation, interpretation of the multi-task tradeoff and limitation concerning depthwise convolutions and GPU runtime remain unchanged. The new evaluations introduce no substantive new interpretation or applicability qualification.

D1.justification: V2 deletes the explicit promise that code and models will become open-source upon acceptance. The repository link and appendix implementation details remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish any change in actual resource availability.

R1.justification: V2 adds dataset and BRISQUE references and changes the retained Chen pipeline's attribution to Blind deblurring for saturated images. The related-work narrative and positioning remain largely unchanged. The newly listed CIDNet reference corresponds to a paper already cited in v1.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized grammar, acronym, notation-explanation and cross-reference edits and inserts an appendix subsection for unpaired evaluations. Most prose and the main section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: V2 adds Table C, a MAC row in Table 1, pipeline columns in Table 2 and ablation rows in Table 6, while removing a row from Table 3. Figure 2 and several appendix figures are relocated. The architecture illustration and qualitative image content are retained.

improvement.justification: V2 modestly strengthens validation through additional unpaired generalization tests, sequential-pipeline controls and targeted component ablations. These provide more direct evidence for the method's applicability and design choices. The gain is limited by the unexplained large Table 3 revision and removal of DarkIR-lol results while the caption still discusses that model.
